locked_test.content_read_before_protocol: none (no report text, MeSH term, label, image, classifier output, retrieval result or metric)

frozen_system.summary: frozen DenseNet-121 (C2-B sqrt-weighted BCE, C4 F1 thresholds, C4 No Finding rule, C5 Platt) -> deterministic routing guard (G1F) -> Top-3 classifier query -> MiniLM dense + BM25 RRF (k=60, depth 100) -> Top-5 -> frozen G1 MedGemma 1.5 4B Single-Agent RAG; empty classifier output -> deterministic INDETERMINATE

evaluation_populations.P0_locked_studies: all 578 locked test studies (report uid is the unit)
evaluation_populations.P1_with_frontal_image: studies with at least one Frontal image; the frontal image is the first Frontal file in sorted filename order (R1 rule)
evaluation_populations.P2_classified: P1 studies whose image passes the frozen ImageValidator and is classified; studies failing the validator are listed with the reason, never silently dropped
evaluation_populations.P3_primary_end_to_end_set: P2 studies with a non-empty cleaned reference report (build_retrieval_text) = the G1 'primary report-generation set'; routing counts are reported on P3 and on P2
evaluation_populations.P4_clinical_finding_subset: P3 studies with a usable mapped truth (has_eval_set under the frozen r1-v1 MeSH mapping); all finding-level, report-state and abstention metrics use P4
evaluation_populations.classification_population: P2 studies with a usable mapped truth (R1 'eligible and classified'); label = class in the mapped truth set, No Finding = truth is exactly {No Finding}; unmapped MeSH terms are NOT verified negatives (precision is a lower bound)
evaluation_populations.retrieval_population: P2 studies with a usable mapped truth and a non-empty classifier query (R1/R2 'primary set')
reported_without_silent_exclusion: routed to Path A / B / C (on P3 and on P2)

classification.definitions: identical to C6: scripts/c6_03_evaluate.evaluate (per-class AUROC/AUPRC/precision/recall/specificity/F1/balanced accuracy, macro and micro averages over defined classes, Brier, log loss, adaptive-bin ECE with 10 bins)
classification.undefined_classes: reported as undefined (no positives or no negatives), never replaced by 0
saved: binary predictions after the No Finding rule
classification.preprocessing_and_inference: frozen: fp32_strict, no TTA, no ensembling, image size 224

routing.rule: src/system/guard.route (frozen); state never derived from prose

retrieval.configuration: frozen R2 (hybrid RRF, Top-5 for generation, Top-10 retained for the K analysis)
metrics: Hit and reciprocal rank (exact finding-set match)
retrieval.oracle_diagnostic: oracle query (the study's true findings) through the same hybrid pipeline on the same population; classifier-query minus oracle gap at K=5; diagnostic only, may not alter the system

generation.system: frozen G1 (prompt hash above); Paths A and B each generated exactly once; Path C returns the frozen indeterminate text without any call
generation.cache: every response cached per study with the request hash and model digest
generation.retry_policy: generate_single: up to 5 attempts for transient errors with exponential back-off (2^attempt s, max 60 s); malformed requests are not retried
generation.persistent_failure_handling: recorded explicitly and listed; never replaced by fabricated or hand-edited text; report metrics are computed on studies with a generated report and the failures are reported as a count with ids; no re-prompting

report_metrics.text_metric_set: P3 (all studies with a final text, including the indeterminate message)
report_metrics.definitions: src/generation/study_eval.study_row (unchanged); finding extractor = frozen Phase 1 lexicon + finding_extraction_changes.yaml; 'stated' = affirmative or hedged mention

outputs: normal and abnormal recall among decided studies

routing_prose_consistency.definition: among studies routed abnormal, the share whose final report prose is read by the frozen extractor as normal / abnormal / indeterminate; abnormal-routing -> normal-prose rate; reports are not repaired; the validation rate (31.0%) is a descriptive comparator and not a target or threshold

provenance.definition: src/generation/metrics.provenance with the study's own Top-5 mapped findings as the retrieval-supported set

copying.definition: src/generation/metrics.copy_stats (min 6 words) against the study's own Top-5 text + repeated-sentence rate; unchanged

rare_findings.caution: no strong claim when counts are very small

bootstrap.unit: study (IU X-Ray has no patient identifier; one frontal image per study); patient-level resampling is not possible for this population
bootstrap.significance_testing: none beyond descriptive intervals and the descriptive Fisher test above

validation_to_test.method: the same analysis code is run on the validation partition (dry run; stored G1/G1F/R1/R2 results must be reproduced) and test-minus-validation absolute differences are reported
validation_to_test.classification_comparator: IU validation (same pipeline and labels); CheXpert C6 validation/test values are listed as context only
validation_to_test.use: descriptive; differences are not used for tuning

failure_taxonomy_frozen.unit: study (P4); a study may fall in several categories; 'no failure' if none

categories.1_classifier_error: classifier non-No-Finding positive set differs from the mapped truth findings
categories.2_normal_abnormal_classifier_mismatch: classifier state (normal/abnormal) differs from the reference state (indeterminate studies are category 8)
categories.3_retrieval_query_mismatch: studies with retrieved context whose Top-5 union contains none of the reference findings (union coverage@5 = 0)
categories.4_retrieval_only_unsupported_finding: the report states a finding with provenance 'retrieval only' that is not in the reference
categories.5_report_generator_omission: the report omits at least one reference finding
categories.6_report_generator_hallucination: the report states at least one finding that is not in the reference
categories.7_abnormal_routing_normal_prose: routed abnormal but the final prose is read as normal
categories.9_corpus_limitation: no corpus report has exactly the reference finding set (exact match impossible)
categories.10_reference_label_limitation: the study has unmapped or uncertain MeSH terms (reference possibly incomplete)

failure_taxonomy_frozen.new_taxonomy_after_inspection: not allowed except clearly marked exploratory

figures_planned: 6 hallucination, omission, FP propagation, TP retention
runtime: G1 generation runtime (per call and total)

analysis_code.development: all F1 analysis code is developed and debugged on the VALIDATION partition only (dry run) and must reproduce the stored validation results before the test is opened; the SHA-256 of every F1 script is recorded in f1_code_freeze.json immediately before the first locked-test access
analysis_code.bug_rule: a code bug found after the test is opened is documented with the corrected code hash and may be fixed only if it invalidates a metric; values are never edited and no scientific choice is changed

no_post_test_tuning: No model, threshold, calibration, query, retrieval setting, Top-K, generator, prompt, routing rule, verifier or postprocessor may be changed after any locked-test reference content or metric is inspected; no study may be excluded because of poor performance; any change would require a new independent test set.
